name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the only clause, soft NotCoExistence(switch_toggled, siren_ringing), is an added requirement — no sentence of the task mentions the switch or the siren, so it must be removed (its normalized_clause text is noise and does not change what the pattern demands). Both rules the task states are missing entirely: (1) 'Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' needs a hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), since 'on your very next move' means the very next step, and a Response would drop that timing; the environment guarantees box_fell never occurs on the step that ends the episode, so the clause is satisfiable. (2) 'If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box' needs a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) alone, with no Existence(at_exit), because reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if' here, not a commanded goal. Both are 'each time'/'if' conditionals, so a rule-only machine with empty FINAL_STATES is fine, but the clause set must be exactly these two hard rules.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' is correctly captured by the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), and 'If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box' is correctly captured by the hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) alone — reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if' sentence, so no Existence(at_exit) is required. The empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid since both sentences are conditionals whose condition events are not commanded.
